text:
Riya (PM): Heads up 1: we need one consolidated acceptance criteria doc for the multi-region + tenant-isolation initiative. Sales and Legal are pushing schedule. Quick ideas?

Anya (Arch): We should separate product-level gates and infra-level gates. Product: affinity, documented DR. Infra: telemetry, policy-as-code, dry-run.

Jorge (Infra): Minimal infra signals: p50/p95 token latency, KV cache hit rate, per-pool GPU util p90, and cross-region egress bytes/sec. Need historic baselines too.

Sam (SRE): Operational gates: 72h dry-run with affinity logging, 30m canary, automatic rollback if error budget increases by >1.5% in 10m, and synthetic route checks every 30s.

Kai (Sales): Customers ask: contractual wording for "isolation" (Legal), monthly drift detection report, and a mechanism for dedicated pool requests. I have 2 enterprise leads blocking.

LegalBot: reminder: any SLA language must be approved by Legal 6 included in the enterprise playbook.

Riya (PM): Draft acceptance checklist (working):
- Affinity: measured tenant affinity >= 99% over 24h dry-run
- Latency: p95 <= 1200ms for target workloads (1k-2k tokens)
- Stability: error rate < 0.5% during 30m canary
- Failover: cross-region fallback completes < 8s and logged
- Observability: telemetry feeds into Console (per-route cost + latency)
- Policy: routing expressed as policy-as-code and supported in dry-run
- Cost: projected per-token cost uplift <= 18% vs baseline
- Compliance: documented DR playbook for region-restricted customers

Anya (Arch): Add: migration path steps: dry-run -> 5% canary -> 25% ramp -> 100% with affinity guardrails and automated eviction if affinity drops >1.2%.

Jorge (Infra): I'll run cost sims on current seq-length distributions and attach before EOD.

Sam (SRE): I'll draft runbook snippets and alert thresholds. Ops wants a feature flag for dry-run and a way to replay logs for audits.

Kai (Sales): I'll consolidate customer asks and escalate the 2 blockers. Legal will need sample SLA language.

Riya (PM): Plan: Ill assemble a one-pager with these gates and a short migration playbook. Well aim to publish to the channel by tomorrow and decide Q2 scope Friday. Thanks all.
__notes: No title field. Thread captures cross-functional discussion to define acceptance gates for routing and tenant isolation roadmap.
